Title: Arrival
Walk_Bus: Uber from HNL with luggage. Skip TheBus with bags.
Rideshare: About $30 to $40 from HNL to Waikiki Malia.
Places: Honolulu International Airport; Waikiki Malia by Outrigger

Title: Diamond Head and Kapahulu
Walk_Bus: Walk or take TheBus 2 / 2L toward Diamond Head Rd for the crater entrance (book State Parks sunrise slot). After the hike, walk or short hop to Kapahulu for Leonard's and a plate lunch. Evening at Kapiolani Park — skip the tourist trolley loop.
Rideshare: Rideshare to Diamond Head if you miss the early bus, about $12 to $18 each way.
Places: Diamond Head State Monument; Leonard's Bakery; Rainbow Drive-In; Kapiolani Park

Title: Koko Head Crater Stairs
Walk_Bus: From Waikiki take 2 / 2L to Kahala Mall, transfer to 23 toward Hawaii Kai / Sea Life Park (or ride 1L toward Hawaii Kai). Get off near Lunalilo Home Rd and Anapalau, walk into Koko Head District Park to the Crater Stairs. Hard hike — water, sun, trail shoes. Optional cool-down at Sandy Beach on 23. Return 23 to Kahala then 2 / 2L to Waikiki. Check DaBus2 or Google Maps Transit that morning.
Rideshare: About $40 to $60 round trip if legs are shot after the stairs.
Car_Backup: Park in the district park lot if you rent a car later in the trip.
Places: Koko Head District Park; Koko Crater Stairs; Sandy Beach

Title: Kuliouou Ridge nature day
Walk_Bus: East-shore free hike day — not Hanauma packages. Take 2 / 2L then 23 (or 1L) toward Hawaii Kai; use Google Maps to the Kuliouou Ridge trailhead stop and walk in. Ridge views without a tour. Alternate chill plan: Ka'iwi / Halona lookouts and shoreline time on the same east corridor. Dinner back toward Kapahulu on the return.
Rideshare: About $40 to $70 if you Uber the last mile to the trailhead.
Car_Backup: Easy by car to the ridge neighborhood trailhead.
Places: Kuliouou Ridge Trailhead; Halona Blowhole Lookout; Ka'iwi Shoreline

Title: North Shore nature day
Walk_Bus: 42 / E / W from Waikiki to Ala Moana Center, then 60 along the windward/North Shore coast (Waimea Bay, shore walks) and/or 52 to Haleiwa town. Swim and walk beaches — no circle-island coach. Optional self-pay Waimea Valley botanical walk if you want a quiet garden (not a tour bus). Local shrimp or poke counters in Haleiwa. Allow 2 to 3 hours each way; start early.
Rideshare: About $90 or more each way — only if the bus day runs long.
Car_Backup: Good car day for beach hopping without schedules.
Places: Waimea Bay; Haleiwa Town; Waimea Valley; Giovanni's Shrimp Truck

Title: Manoa Falls and Lyon Arboretum
Walk_Bus: TheBus 13 (or 6 via UH / Manoa) toward the Manoa Falls area; walk the rainforest trail. Add Lyon Arboretum for quieter native plants if open and you have energy. Return toward Kapahulu for Ono Seafood or Leonard's (walk or short 2 / 13). Trails can be muddy — shoes with grip.
Car_Backup: Park near the trailhead / arboretum if driving.
Places: Manoa Falls Trailhead; Lyon Arboretum; Ono Seafood; Leonard's Bakery

Title: Makapu'u Lighthouse
Walk_Bus: 2 / 2L to Kahala Mall, transfer to 23 toward Makapu'u / Sea Life Park. Walk the paved lighthouse trail (about 2 miles round trip). Winter mornings are good for shore whale watching — no cruise needed. Return the same way. Sunrise means checking the first buses in DaBus2.
Rideshare: About $40 to $70 round trip for an early start.
Car_Backup: Early car helps if buses are sparse at dawn.
Places: Makapu'u Lighthouse Trail; Makapu'u Lookout; Sandy Beach

Title: Lanikai Pillbox and Ulupo Heiau
Walk_Bus: 42 / E / W to Ala Moana, transfer to 67 toward Kailua. Use 671 for Kailua Beach / Lanikai area. Hike Lanikai Pillbox (short, steep). Swim Kailua Beach. Walk or short bus to Ulupo Heiau by Kawainui — free cultural site, no tour. Skip paid windward vans.
Rideshare: About $50 to $80 if you rideshare Pillbox or Ulupo links.
Car_Backup: Early car helps for Pillbox parking limits.
Places: Lanikai Pillbox Trail; Kailua Beach Park; Ulupo Heiau; Kalapawai Cafe

Title: Ho'omaluhia and Pali
Walk_Bus: 42 / E / W to Ala Moana, then 60 to Ho'omaluhia Botanical Garden (free, bring water). Kawainui marsh paths if energy allows (67 area). Nuuanu Pali Lookout for the historic pass view — short rideshare is simplest from windward, or plan a careful bus+walk. Optional small-fee self-guided Byodo-In on 65 if you want a quiet temple stop. No windward circle tour.
Rideshare: About $40 to $80 for Pali / Byodo-In links.
Car_Backup: Car loops Ho'omaluhia, Kawainui, and Pali easily.
Places: Ho'omaluhia Botanical Garden; Kawainui Marsh; Nuuanu Pali Lookout; Byodo-In Temple

Title: Local culture and town
Walk_Bus: Self-guided town day: TheBus 2 / 13 / 42 toward downtown / Chinatown. Maunakea Marketplace for local snacks. Walk the civic historic core and Kawaiaha'o exterior. Optional paid self-guided Iolani Palace interior only if you want tickets — otherwise neighborhood walk. Afternoon swim at a calmer stretch or Ala Moana Beach Park (42 / E / W). Plate lunch over mall shopping.
Rideshare: Not needed for town; short hops only.
Places: Maunakea Marketplace; Kawaiaha'o Church; Iolani Palace; Ala Moana Beach Park

Title: Departure day
Walk_Bus: Uber for Pu'u Ualaka'a (Tantalus) sunrise viewpoint. Check out by noon and store bags. Optional Bishop Museum for self-guided Hawaiian culture (TheBus 2 only if bags are stored). Punchbowl then Uber to HNL with luggage — do not bus with bags.
Rideshare: Uber for Tantalus, Punchbowl, and the airport.
Car_Backup: Return any rental at the airport or Waikiki.
Places: Pu'u Ualaka'a State Park; Bishop Museum; National Memorial Cemetery of the Pacific; Honolulu International Airport
